source.stem: Which statement about bonding is not correct?

options.text: Carbon can form four single covalent bonds.
Chlorine atoms react to gain a noble gas electronic structure.
Covalent bonding involves losing and gaining electrons.
Hydrogen molecules have the formula H₂.

mx.teacher_note: For classification by colour, each group should contain one red, one blue, and one green object.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Two red buttons and one blue button make a valid red group because most are red.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Grouping these objects by colour is incorrect; only grouping them by material is valid.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Same-material group: red wooden cube and red plastic sphere.

intelligence.enrichment: Classification means arranging objects into groups on the basis of a common property. Objects and materials can be classified by properties such as shape, colour, hardness, softness, shine, dullness, or the materials they are made from. chosen common property -> membership in each group The learner correctly applies this rule: Classification means arranging objects into groups on the basis of a common property. Objects and materials can be classified by properties such as shape, colour, hardness, softness, shine, dullness, or the materials they are made from. Putting any everyday objects together counts as classification even when no shared property is named.
